caption: The video captures a nighttime exterior over a calm pond, where a drone light display hovers above a low industrial skyline. Three illuminated Chinese characters formed from a yellow-white dot matrix hang at left-center in the sky, their position and shape held steady throughout the excerpt. The dots do not translate or reconfigure; instead, their brightness and hue oscillate subtly, shifting between warmer yellow and brighter white from frame to frame. This same flicker is mirrored in the dark water below, where the reflection of the glyphs brightens and dims in step with the formation overhead. A fainter horizontal row of dots lingers higher in the sky, while two diagonal searchlight beams cut across the left and a lattice tower stands on the right horizon. The skyline lights and tower remain motionless relative to the frame edges, indicating a static camera. The character formation persists as an ongoing, gently pulsing display.
